title: TINS markers
description: The canonical marker block every TINS consumer must include at the top of its SPEC.md, BUILDER-DECISIONS-REVIEW.md, and REVIEWER-DECISIONS-REVIEW.md. Validated by the kit's validate.mjs §8.1.

tins_version.description: The TINS methodology version this consumer follows (semver, e.g. 1.0.0).

kit_version.description: The tins-kit version this consumer was built against (semver). The consumer's selftest can check this against the kit's current version to detect drift.

path.description: The consumer's repo path relative to the kit root (e.g. '../atal-incubation/').

kind.description: The kind of file this marker is embedded in.

as_of.description: The date this marker block was last updated (ISO 8601 date).

patterns_in_use.description: The list of kit patterns this consumer has adopted. Validated against the kit's `ls lib/patterns/`. Any pattern in this list must exist in the kit; any pattern the consumer is using but not in this list is flagged.

modules_in_use.description: The list of kit lib modules this consumer has adopted.
